nodes.label: Not a Meta-Analysis (scope boundary)
nodes.rationale: The pipeline deliberately does not pool effect estimates, compute I2, or produce forest plots, because pooled estimates require homogeneity assumptions the corpus rarely satisfies; effect-direction tabulation plus explained conflict is the substitute method.

nodes.label: Offline Fixture Testing (eval.py, DEEP_RESEARCH_FIXTURES)
nodes.rationale: Fixture replay and record modes let the search client be tested without network or credentials, so evals stay deterministic and cheap.

nodes.label: No Pip Installs Constraint
nodes.rationale: Scripts are restricted to python3 stdlib plus requests and pdfminer so the skill runs on an unprovisioned machine; lxml/bs4/PyYAML are absent by design, hence xml.etree and a hand-written YAML serializer.

nodes.label: Run Profiles (fast/standard/systematic/max)
nodes.rationale: Bundles scope, rigor, gates and max_articles into one user-facing choice so Stage 0 asks one question instead of four; every field remains individually overridable in config.json.

nodes.label: Connector Preflight
nodes.rationale: Tool availability is a property of the session, not the skill: MCP servers attach at session start, so a claim about connectivity carries an expiry date and must never be copied across sessions or baked into the skill file. A max run without Scholar Gateway and Consensus is wide with extra steps and must say so rather than quietly returning less.

nodes.label: Run Directory Layout
nodes.rationale: Reserved directories hold exactly one record shape each because corpus.py reads every *.json in them as a record of that stage's type; a stray file of the wrong shape used to crash prisma/screen-ingest with a bare AttributeError.

nodes.label: Stage Pointer
nodes.rationale: config.json's stage field is the only thing a resume trusts; a coordinator that carries the stage in its head leaves the pointer stale and sends the next session back to a stage already done.

nodes.label: Bounded-Subagent Delegation Rules
nodes.rationale: Subagents get bounded inputs and return only a one-line receipt so main context stays small over a long run; they write their own result files and the coordinator reads from disk. Subagents cannot spawn subagents.

nodes.label: Subagent Shell Hygiene (never ls)
nodes.rationale: A user alias mapping ls to eza hung indefinitely on an iCloud-backed run directory and wedged a subagent's shell for 45 minutes after its work had finished; the agent still returned its receipt, so the run looked clean while the process lingered at 0% CPU. Verify with find or a python3 one-liner instead.

nodes.label: Task Board (taskboard.jsonl)
nodes.rationale: Never hand-edited; corpus.py task is its only writer so inputs_hash and timestamps stay computed. Resume is by task, not by stage, and completed outputs are immutable unless inputs_hash changes.

nodes.label: No-Progress Guard
nodes.rationale: Every recording call appends a probe, so polling the guard while a run is legitimately parked manufactures the flat window it looks for; --no-record exists for status checks, and an empty board now reports idle rather than a stall.

nodes.label: Health Alerts (degraded runs must be announced)
nodes.rationale: A degraded run looks exactly like a healthy one unless the coordinator says otherwise; silence is a bug, not tact. Never report a stage complete when part of it silently did not run, and treat an empty result as a finding rather than widening the query until the number looks respectable.
nodes.norm_label: health alerts (degraded runs must be announced)

nodes.label: No Paywall Circumvention (fail closed)
nodes.rationale: No credentials, no browser automation for access, no pirate mirrors. The OA ladder is the whole ladder. A missing paper is an honest gap in the report; a circumvented paywall is a policy breach.

nodes.label: Quarantine → Inbox → Resume Loop
nodes.rationale: The run never stalls on an unobtainable paper: it quarantines, keeps going, marks the synthesis provisional, and hands the human a list with direct links so they can supply the PDF themselves.

nodes.label: Wiki Boundary (research/ owned, wiki/ never written)
nodes.rationale: <wiki>/wiki/ belongs to wiki-manager (OKF 0.1) and is never written to; deep-research owns <wiki>/research/ (OKF 0.2-style). The two bundles are format-incompatible on purpose.
nodes.norm_label: wiki boundary (research/ owned, wiki/ never written)

nodes.label: Full-Text Acquisition Ladder (rungs 0-7)
nodes.rationale: Rungs are walked in order until text is in hand; the succeeding rung is recorded as source_tier + access_route so provenance of every full text is auditable.

nodes.label: HTML Truncation Detector
nodes.rationale: Fires on <1500 body words or one of five paywall marker strings, downgrading the record to abstract_only. Deliberately trigger-happy: a false abstract_only costs a label, a false fulltext corrupts the appraisal.

nodes.label: OCR Fallback (pdftotext → pdfminer → tesseract)
nodes.rationale: OCR runs only when the first two extractors yield under 100 characters, is capped at 30 pages, and is recorded in the rung detail; ocrmypdf is not installed so there is no whole-file OCR path.

nodes.label: Rung 1 PubMed MCP Coordinator Handoff
nodes.rationale: get_full_text_article is an MCP tool a script cannot call, so fulltext.py appends a needs_mcp task and keeps walking the ladder — the run never blocks on rung 1. The coordinator makes the call and hands text back via resolve-mcp.

nodes.label: Library Matching Thresholds (sha256/DOI/PMID/PMCID/fuzzy title)
nodes.rationale: Inbox ingestion uses a looser 0.85 page threshold than the 0.90 title-to-title threshold because layout and OCR noise inflate the denominator; titles under 25 normalized characters are never fuzzy-matched as too collision-prone.

nodes.label: PDF Library Git Policy
nodes.rationale: index.json is versioned while PDFs are not; a negation inside an ignored directory does not work in gitignore, hence the four-line managed block.

nodes.label: Acquisition Resumability
nodes.rationale: Per-record rung state means terminal rungs are never re-attempted; --offline reports network rungs as skipped rather than failed so a later online pass still tries them.

nodes.label: Forbidden Acquisition Approaches
nodes.rationale: Browser automation, institutional credentials, pirate mirrors, UA rotation and retrying a 403 by another route are never implemented, not merely unimplemented. A browser rung exists only to defeat access controls; a refusal is a refusal.

nodes.label: Appraisal Tool Selection by Design
nodes.rationale: Exactly one tool per study, driven by the extracted design. tool:none is a legitimate common outcome, not a failure — applying AMSTAR-2 to a narrative review manufactures a critically_low that reads as a quality verdict on work that never claimed to be systematic.

nodes.label: RoB 2 (randomized trials)
nodes.rationale: Assessed per result and per outcome, for a stated effect of interest (assignment vs adherence); domain 2 branches on that choice. Signalling questions are answered first and the domain judgement derived from them, never reverse-engineered.

nodes.label: ROBINS-I (non-randomized studies)
nodes.rationale: Overall is the worst domain judgement — no averaging, no compensation. Judged against a hypothetical target trial written down before domain 1, which forces explicit confounder lists and time-zero alignment checks.

nodes.label: Target-Trial Framing
nodes.rationale: Writing down eligibility, treatment, assignment, outcome and follow-up before appraising turns vague judgement into deviation-from-a-specified-trial, surfacing immortal time and prevalent-user bias that would otherwise be assumed absent.

nodes.label: Newcastle-Ottawa Scale
nodes.rationale: The NOS defines no good/fair/poor thresholds; any cutoff is the reviewer's and must be declared before use. A star count is not a risk-of-bias judgement and must not be translated into 'low risk' in prose.

nodes.label: AMSTAR-2 (systematic reviews)
nodes.rationale: Rates confidence in the review's results, not certainty of the underlying evidence; a critically_low must not be restated as 'very low certainty' — that is GRADE's job.

nodes.label: Saying Unclear Honestly (rules U1-U4)
nodes.rationale: The single largest failure mode of automated appraisal is converting silence into reassurance. Absence of reporting is never evidence of low risk; three different silences (not reported, not assessable from this source, reported as absent) must be distinguished; never infer from journal, funder, sample size or registration.

nodes.label: Abstract-Only Restricted Appraisal
nodes.rationale: A record with five unclear domains and one weakly-supported judgement communicates less than an honest 'not appraised: abstract only', so tool:none is preferred when no domain is assessable. A truncation-detected HTML fetch is abstract-only, never 'partial full text'.

nodes.label: GRADE Certainty Rating
nodes.rationale: Rated per outcome across the body of studies, not per study. Five downgrade and three upgrade domains; no double-counting a problem under two domains; certainty is about the estimate, not importance — 'low certainty' never means 'no effect'.

nodes.label: GRADE Certainty Wording (verbatim shapes)
nodes.rationale: Fixed verb forms ('reduces' / 'probably reduces' / 'may reduce' / 'the evidence is very uncertain about') make certainty legible in prose and are the permitted evidence-side vocabulary at the hard wall.

nodes.label: Evidence Kernel (evidence-proof layer)
nodes.rationale: Turns four failure modes — fabricated quote, invented source, stale evidence, tampered snapshot — from 'hopefully caught in review' into 'mechanically rejected'.

nodes.label: Agent-Written Text Is Never Evidence
nodes.rationale: An agent may say what it concluded and where it read it, but may not supply the reading. Quotation marks and page numbers are free and survive review because nobody re-opens the PDF; excerpts are therefore re-sliced by script twice, at assembly and at publish.

nodes.label: Immutable Snapshot Store
nodes.rationale: Write-once via O_EXCL with content-addressed ids and an independent body hash; text is stored decoded-UTF-8 and never normalized so offsets under an existing claim never drift. PDFs are not duplicated — the snapshot records a wiki-root-relative asset path instead.

nodes.label: Fresh-Fetch Rule
nodes.rationale: A supported verdict counts only if every backing source has a fetch or local_pdf event in this run with a hash that still matches. Register events, read events, cache-only fetches, cross-run events, search snippets and existing wiki notes deliberately do not count.

nodes.label: User-Supplied-PDF Freshness Exception
nodes.rationale: For origin user-supplied-pdf there is nothing to re-fetch and possibly no lawful URL, so the immutable hash-checked local file is the fresh source. The exception exists because a user handing over a PDF is a real acquisition route, not because retrieval rules are negotiable.

nodes.label: Claim Span Contract
nodes.rationale: start inclusive, end exclusive, character offsets into the snapshot's decoded text (Unicode code points, not bytes) — the single ambiguity most likely to produce silent plausible-looking corruption, so it is closed explicitly. Max 2000 chars; over-length is a failure, never a truncation.

nodes.label: Assembler Gate
nodes.rationale: Derives URLs, excerpts, sections, pages and paper ids from snapshots, never from agent output; where the two disagree the snapshot wins and the artifact is rejected rather than silently corrected, because a silent correction hides that an agent asserted something false.

nodes.label: Evidence-Kernel Gate Default Off
nodes.rationale: The gate is built, wired and always reported but non-blocking until a live end-to-end run passes, so rollout risk does not silently reduce reporting. Tamper failures (C-SNAPSHOT, C-SPAN) block promotion regardless — that is not a rollout concern.

nodes.label: Publisher Integrity Preflight (okf.py promote --check)
nodes.rationale: Re-reads snapshots, recomputes hashes and re-slices every excerpt a second time before any concept file is created. Promotion fails closed — never a partial bundle — while run outputs, report.md above all, are preserved.

nodes.label: OKF 0.2 Bundle Frontmatter Spec
nodes.rationale: An OKF-style convention owned by deep-research, not wiki-manager's OKF 0.1 and not an external standard; consumers must tolerate unknown concept types (open-world rule).

nodes.label: Bundle Boundary Rules B1-B5
nodes.rationale: The two bundles are format-incompatible on purpose so frontmatter is never copied between them; a research/ tree without a conforming root is not a deep-research bundle and okf.py initializes rather than writing into an unmarked tree.

nodes.label: Concept Taxonomy and Paths
nodes.rationale: Paths are durable: stable concepts never live under a run directory, so knowledge outlives the run that produced it.

nodes.label: PubMed Bibliographic Frontmatter Block
nodes.rationale: pmid, doi, pmcid, volume, issue and pages are always quoted strings so YAML never coerces a volume like '07' into an integer; fields are populated from corpus.jsonl and PubMed only, nothing fabricated to fill a slot.

nodes.label: Per-Claim Footnote Attribution
nodes.rationale: Every evidence-bearing statement carries a markdown footnote keyed to a sources[].id; a body-only References list is not acceptable attribution because it lets a claim float free of its source.

nodes.label: Markdown Links as the Graph Layer
nodes.rationale: Standard markdown links carry every bundle-internal edge; Obsidian wikilinks are additive only, and a concept whose only link to a target is a wikilink is treated as unlinked so the graph stays tool-independent.
nodes.norm_label: markdown links as the graph layer

nodes.label: OKF Validation Rules V1-V25
nodes.rationale: Each rule is machine-checkable; any violation keeps the report but blocks wiki promotion and writes outputs/okf-validation.md.

nodes.label: log.md Append Convention
nodes.rationale: ISO date headings, newest last, append-only — prior entries are never reordered or rewritten so the log is an audit trail rather than a summary.

nodes.label: PRISMA 2020 Flow Counters
nodes.rationale: Counter names map one-to-one onto PRISMA 2020 boxes and satisfy arithmetic invariants the verifier enforces, so the flow cannot silently fail to close.

nodes.label: Report Raw Agreement, Never Kappa-by-Assertion
nodes.rationale: A kappa is reported only if actually computed from the full contingency table, named as Cohen's kappa and shown with the table; presenting raw agreement as kappa manufactures a statistic nobody computed.

nodes.label: Citation Rules R1-R6
nodes.rationale: A claim resting on three studies carries three footnote references, not one covering footnote; footnotes carry the appraisal verdict and evidence basis inline so abstract-only labelling survives copy-paste. Uncitable background statements are cut, not softened.

nodes.label: Report Skeleton (16 sections)
nodes.rationale: Each section names its data source and verify.py checks section presence; empty-with-a-stated-reason is acceptable, missing is not.

nodes.label: Honest Statement Patterns
nodes.rationale: Abstract-only basis is labelled in three places every time (point of use, footnote, evidence table); quarantined papers are named with PMIDs rather than described as 'a small number'; preprints are tagged loudly; retracted work carries RETRACTED at every point of use.

nodes.label: Verifier Reporting Checks (C-*)
nodes.rationale: Any fail makes the report provisional and blocks OKF promotion, but the report is still delivered — a failed check withholds the wiki write, never the deliverable.

nodes.label: JSON Schema Contracts Index
nodes.rationale: Split into one file per record so a reader who needs one contract does not load the other thirteen; subagents read their prompt block instead, since a subagent reading this tree is spending context it should be spending on its paper.

nodes.label: Why MeSH Alone Is Always Wrong
nodes.rationale: Indexing lag, descriptor drift, absent descriptors and indexer disagreement mean the most recent 6-12 months — usually the part the user cares about — is reachable only by text words. Consequence: every concept facet is (MeSH OR text-word).
nodes.norm_label: why mesh alone is always wrong

nodes.label: E-utilities Field Tags and Filters
nodes.rationale: [dp] is unstable for ahead-of-print records while [edat] is stable and makes a rerun reproducible, so the date type used is logged in query_string. Sample size, funding and setting are not queryable and are applied at screening.

nodes.label: Validated Design Hedges (Cochrane HSSS, SIGN)
nodes.rationale: The animal exclusion must be NOT (Animals[mh] NOT Humans[mh]) — plain NOT Animals[mh] drops every mixed human/animal record. Filters are re-verified against canonical sources before systematic/max runs and never presented as verbatim published ones when adapted.

nodes.label: Null/Negative-Findings Hedge
nodes.rationale: Not optional: it is the operationalization of the invariant that null and negative findings are actively searched for rather than whatever happens to surface.

nodes.label: Citation Chaining (elink)
nodes.rationale: A different entry point, not another boolean query — it finds papers whose wording the vocabulary missed. Chaining amplifies the seed set's citation bias, so seeds must be at least three independent records including one null-result paper. Chaining that is not logged does not exist.

nodes.label: Orthogonal Query Design (four axes)
nodes.rationale: Prevents eight queries that are one query with synonyms shuffled, producing one hit set, ~0% marginal yield, and a search log that only looks thorough. Orthogonality is a property of hit sets, not strings: two queries must differ on 2+ axes AND satisfy Jaccard < 0.6 with >=15% unique yield.

nodes.label: Hit-Set Overlap Report (overlap.py)
nodes.rationale: Jaccard alone is insufficient — date-slicing scores J=0 while adding no new concepts — so the axis profile must differ too and both tests must pass. Remediation replaces a failing query's axis value rather than deleting it, since deleting shrinks the recorded strategy without improving it.

nodes.label: Query Execution and Logging Contract (L1-L7)
nodes.rationale: Reading translated_query is mandatory before accepting a result: it reveals truncation that suppressed term mapping, a mistyped [mh] that silently mapped to [tw], and unintended explosion. A count:0 query is still logged — zero hits is a result.

nodes.label: Unit of Synthesis (outcome × timepoint × comparison)
nodes.rationale: Never per study and never 'overall'. Timepoint bands are declared in the protocol before synthesis so they cannot be invented per outcome to make results line up.

nodes.label: Effect-Direction Tabulation
nodes.rationale: Vote counting done properly: direction plus magnitude plus precision plus weight-proxy plus risk of bias, never a bare count of positive studies. A p-value alone never yields a direction, and a study without an interval is 'unreported', not evidence of no effect.

nodes.label: No Pooled Estimates (hard constraint)
nodes.rationale: Where a pooled estimate or I2 appears it is extracted from a published meta-analysis and attributed to it, never produced here. A forest plot may be drawn without a diamond, because a diamond asserts a pooled estimate this pipeline did not compute.

nodes.label: Three Kinds of Heterogeneity
nodes.rationale: Clinical, methodological and statistical must be named separately. I2 is not an absolute measure and depends on study precision; Cochrane's bands overlap on purpose and are never thresholds. Prediction intervals are preferred to pooled CIs for what the evidence implies in a new setting.

nodes.label: Conflict Taxonomy C1-C9
nodes.rationale: Worked in order, stopping at the first cause the data support, with C9 (chance/imprecision) checked first so noise is not given a manufactured explanation. An unexplained conflict is a legitimate reportable finding that feeds GRADE inconsistency; a conflict is not a defect in the report, an unexplained-but-unstated one is.

nodes.label: Publication-Bias Signals Without Meta-Analysis
nodes.rationale: Funnel plots and Egger tests need ~10 studies and a pooled analysis, neither available here, so registry-versus-publication, outcome switching, small-study ordering and funding asymmetry substitute. When none can be assessed, write 'publication bias could not be assessed', not 'no evidence of publication bias'.

nodes.label: The Hard Wall (evidence vs hypotheses)
nodes.rationale: Two sections, never mixed, never adjacent in a paragraph, never in one sentence, with disjoint permitted verb forms. Every hypothesis states what would test it — a hypothesis with no test is speculation and is dropped — and may never later be cited as a finding. Gaps are observations and sit on the evidence side; explanations for gaps sit on the hypothesis side.

nodes.label: Provisional Synthesis Triggers
nodes.rationale: PROVISIONAL appears in the title block, not only a footnote, and each affected synthesis unit states the shortfall locally at the point of the claim. The direction of possible bias is stated where it can be reasoned about and stated as unknown where it cannot. A provisional synthesis is still delivered — never silently completed, never withheld.

nodes.label: Screening Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: The prompt body is a complete verified transcription of the screening-verdict and receipt contracts, so the subagent never loads the 900-line schema tree it does not need.

nodes.label: Screening Decision Rules
nodes.rationale: Criteria are evaluated in protocol order and the first failing id recorded; 'unclear' is a legitimate expected output and must not be coerced into 'exclude' to look decisive; outcome positivity is never a screening criterion because null and negative findings are actively wanted; quality is stage 6, not here.

nodes.label: Shared Subagent Output Directory
nodes.rationale: Concurrent screeners write into one directory, so the prompt states this explicitly — otherwise subagents waste turns investigating and auditing their siblings' files.

nodes.label: Adjudicator Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: Adjudicate against the criteria, not against the screeners: no defaulting to one screener, no majority, no splitting the difference, no preferring include to keep evidence or exclude to save budget. Both verdicts are copied verbatim because agreement data feeds the PRISMA screening log and altering them corrupts the statistic.

nodes.label: Extraction Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: One paper per subagent, opus. Extract only from the supplied snapshot — no prior knowledge, no fetching. Null and negative results are extracted with the same care as positive ones.

nodes.label: Evidence Is an Offset, Not a Sentence You Typed
nodes.rationale: Transcribed text is discarded and, where it mismatches the re-slice, the claim is rejected; off-by-one offsets fail the same way an invented quote fails, so start/end are copied from source.py window headers rather than counted by hand. A number without a span is worse than a missing number.
nodes.norm_label: evidence is an offset, not a sentence you typed

nodes.label: quotes[] Is Derived, Never Written
nodes.rationale: The extraction record's quotes array is always [] from the agent and is filled by the assembler from the spans, so no excerpt in the pipeline was ever typed by a model.

nodes.label: null Is Not 'none declared'
nodes.rationale: For funding and COI, null means the paper did not state it, which is materially different from the paper stating there was none; conflating the two invents a fact about the study.

nodes.label: Appraisal Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: One paper per subagent, opus. Unlike the other prompt blocks it deliberately does send the appraiser to references/appraisal.md, because an appraiser that has not read the domain rules will pick the wrong tool.

nodes.label: Spans Required for Every Non-Unclear Judgement
nodes.rationale: 'low' requires a positive statement in the paper you can point to; an 'unclear' grounded in absent reporting takes spans:[] because there is nothing to point at, and saying so is the honest record. The rationale says what you concluded, the span says where you read it.
nodes.norm_label: spans required for every non-unclear judgement

nodes.label: Review Protocol Template
nodes.rationale: Written in stage 1 before any search runs; the criteria ids defined here are the only ids screening may cite and are never renumbered after screening starts — deviations are appended and logged instead.

nodes.label: Protocol Deviations Log
nodes.rationale: Append-only, newest last, recording every departure from the locked protocol so the strategy stays auditable rather than retroactively tidy.

nodes.label: report.md Template
nodes.rationale: The primary deliverable's skeleton: a claim without a footnote keyed to an evidence_id retrieved this run does not belong in sections 1-8; if it is the agent's own inference it belongs in the hypotheses section and nowhere else.

nodes.label: report.qmd Quarto Template
nodes.rationale: Quarto twin of report.md with the same sections, order and hard wall; the only difference is citations resolve as [@key] against refs.bib generated by render.py from corpus.jsonl, with keys being slugified evidence_ids. Never cite a key render.py did not emit.

nodes.label: report.html Standalone Template
nodes.rationale: Self-contained deliverable built by html_report.py with CSS design tokens encoding effect direction and risk of bias; colour is secondary to shape and the blue/orange/grey direction palette is chosen to be CVD-safe.
